claims: The 2026 NFL Draft takes place from Thursday, April 23, through Saturday, April 25, 2026, in Pittsburgh, PA.
The 2026 NFL Draft is a three-day event.
The 2026 NFL Draft features 257 total picks.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be held at Acrisure Stadium.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be held at Point State Park.
The 2026 NFL Draft will have coverage on ESPN.
The 2026 NFL Draft will have coverage on ABC.
The 2026 NFL Draft will have coverage on NFL Network.
Round 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft takes place on Thursday, April 23, at 8 p.m. Eastern.
Rounds 2-3 of the 2026 NFL Draft take place on Friday, April 24, at 7 p.m. Eastern.
Rounds 4-7 of the 2026 NFL Draft take place on Saturday, April 25, at Noon Eastern.
The 2026 NFL Draft features a rule change, with the time between selections in the first round reduced from 10 minutes to eight minutes.
